turns.message: What CS2 sensitivity matches my VALORANT sensitivity?
turns.fallbackReason: Fallback mode is selected in the research controls.
turns.reply: Hipfire Mouse Sensitivity (360° Distance) (Similar function with differences): Both games expose raw yaw-based hipfire sensitivity sliders. Under default yaw scaling (VALORANT 0.07 deg/count vs CS2 m_yaw 0.022 deg/count), multiplying VALORANT hipfire sensitivity by 0.07 / 0.022 (≈ 3.1818) matches physical mouse distance for a 360° turn. 360° starting point (VALORANT -> CS2): 0.4 × (0.07 / 0.022) ≈ 1.27. Matches physical 360° hipfire turn distance — NOT identical screen-space speed because horizontal FOV differs (VALORANT 103° vs CS2 ~106.26° at 16:9).
